title: Notice regarding consideration of an application for approval of an extension of the filing deadline of Annual Securities Report for the 53rd Fiscal Year
excerpt: Preliminary fiscal-year figures exclude accounting corrections and unresolved quality and customs impacts.
summary: Nidec reported unaudited preliminary fiscal-2025 sales of JPY 2.700 trillion, cash of JPY 850 billion, interest-bearing debt of JPY 1.110 trillion and net debt of JPY 260 billion. The issuer explicitly excluded the accounting corrections and the financial impacts of unresolved quality and customs investigations, so the figures do not establish an audited valuation base.
